description: The synchronize/rerun flow: the stub serves an existing review comment under this duty's own marker (a bot author, a prior review of the same pull request at an earlier head SHA). The model's finding at the same rule/path/line carries a different claim, so reconcile marks it `changed` and the run replaces its own comment in place — the PATCH `issues/comments/{id}` path, never a second POST. The `wrote: patch` assertion pins exactly that: a rerun must update, not stack.
